description: Maps one voltage range onto another, rescaling and offsetting a control voltage

params.text: Sets the bottom of the expected input range, -10V to +10V; an input at this voltage comes out at the lower of the two limits
Sets the top of the expected input range, up to 10V and never below MIN; an input at this voltage comes out at the higher of the two limits
Sets one end of the output range, -10V to +10V. With a cable in the CV input that goes with it, this knob attenuverts that voltage instead
Sets the other end of the output range, -10V to +10V. With a cable in the CV input that goes with it, this knob attenuverts that voltage instead

inputs.text: The voltage to be rescaled; polyphonic, with every channel scaled by the same settings. Anything outside the MIN to MAX range is clipped to it
Sets limit A from a voltage, with the LIMIT A knob attenuverting it
Sets limit B from a voltage, with the LIMIT B knob attenuverting it

notes: the two lamps light when the input goes below MIN or above MAX, showing that it is being clipped
menu: Preset — offers Scale ±5V to 0-10V and Scale 0-10V to ±5V, each setting the four range knobs for that mapping
